guides.title: What to do when your child falls behind
guides.summary: Is your child a late bloomer? Don't write them off. See how an average student named Stephen Hawking changed science, plus 5 ways to back a child who's blooming slowly.

guides.title: How to protect your child's imagination
guides.summary: Your child's imagination is their superpower. Learn why it matters, what kills it, and 5 simple ways to protect it — plus the Disney story every parent should know.

guides.title: What to do when school labels your child
guides.summary: Every child learns differently — and school doesn't always see it. Learn why “slow” labels are so often wrong, and 5 ways to teach to your child's real strengths.

guides.title: How to teach your child that dreams take work
guides.summary: Dreams need hard work — and kids need to learn it early. See how A.P.J. Abdul Kalam rose from selling newspapers, plus 5 ways to pair your child's big dreams with daily effort.

guides.title: How to help a quiet child find their voice
guides.summary: Want to help your child find their voice? See how Helen Keller learned to communicate against all odds, plus 5 gentle ways to help a quiet child speak up with confidence.

guides.title: Why practice beats talent - and how to build it
guides.summary: Practice beats talent far more often than parents think. See how Serena Williams trained on public courts, plus 5 ways to help your child build a practice habit that wins.

guides.title: How to raise a child who dares
guides.summary: Want to raise a child who dares? See how Mary Kom boxed past every “you can't,” plus 5 ways to grow a brave child who takes on challenges instead of shrinking from them.

guides.title: How to raise a resourceful child
guides.summary: More gadgets won't help — but a resourceful child will thrive anywhere. See how Sundar Pichai grew up with little, plus 5 ways to raise a child who solves their own problems.

guides.title: 5 ways to grow a quiet child's leadership
guides.summary: Quiet kids can lead too — louder isn't better. See how soft-spoken Ratan Tata led a global empire, plus 5 ways to grow a shy child's quiet strength into real leadership.

guides.title: How to teach your child to speak up
guides.summary: Want to teach your child to speak up? See how Malala raised her voice at 11, plus 5 ways to help your child share opinions, set boundaries, and stand up for what's right.

guides.title: 5 simple ways to grow a late talking child's words
guides.summary: Worried about a late talking child? Learn what's normal, the milestones to watch, and how to gently grow your child's words — plus why even Einstein spoke late.

guides.title: How to channel a high-energy child: 4 steps
guides.summary: Got a restless child who can't sit still? That energy may be a gift. Here's how to channel a high-energy kid's drive into focus, confidence, and a real strength.

guides.title: 4 things that actually help a child who stammers
guides.summary: Worried about a child who stammers? Hrithik Roshan stammered as a kid too. Here's what helps a stuttering child speak with confidence — and what to avoid.

guides.title: How to raise a struggling reader who believes in themselves
guides.summary: Dyslexia in children is not a lack of intelligence. Richard Branson is dyslexic. Here's how to turn a struggling reader's brain into creativity, grit, and a real strength.

guides.title: 4 ways to feed your child's curiosity
guides.summary: Curiosity in children is a superpower for learning. Leonardo da Vinci never stopped asking why. Here's how to feed your child's questions instead of shutting them down.

guides.title: What to do when your child says 'I'm bored'
guides.summary: Boredom is good for kids. J.K. Rowling dreamed up Harry Potter bored on a delayed train. Here's why an unscheduled, bored child becomes a creative one — and how to allow it.

guides.title: 4 ways to raise an opportunity-spotter
guides.summary: Want to raise an entrepreneur? Dhirubhai Ambani started with almost nothing and built an empire. Here's how to teach your child to spot opportunity and create value early.

guides.title: 4 ways to raise a confident young speaker
guides.summary: Public speaking for kids is a superpower. Oprah was speaking to audiences by age 3. Here's how to raise a child who can hold a room — confident, clear, and comfortable speaking up.

guides.title: How to raise a child who loves reading
guides.summary: Want to raise a child who loves reading? Bill Gates devoured books as a kid. Here's how to grow a reader — and why reading early shapes the brain, vocabulary, and success.

guides.title: How to build self-belief (the right way)
guides.summary: When the world says your child is 'too small' or 'not enough,' believe in your child anyway. Messi was told he was too small. Here's how to build unshakeable self-belief in kids.

guides.title: What to say instead: 7 phrases that build a growth mindset
guides.summary: Praising your child for being smart can backfire. Learn how to praise your child's effort the right way to build confidence, grit, and a growth mindset.

guides.title: 3 things to say instead of 'calm down'
guides.summary: Telling an angry child to calm down rarely works. Learn how to calm an angry child with co-regulation, naming feelings, and three phrases that actually settle big emotions.

guides.title: How to give choices the right way
guides.summary: Want to get kids to cooperate without yelling? Give two choices instead of one order. Learn how offering choices ends power struggles and builds decision-making skills.

guides.title: 3 mistakes that close the door
guides.summary: If your child won't open up, stop sitting across from them. Learn how to get your child to talk to you using side-by-side connection, the car, and questions that actually work.

guides.title: How to teach the 2-second pause
guides.summary: Want your child to speak with confidence? Teach the 2-second pause. Learn how a short, calm pause makes kids sound clear, confident, and in control when they talk.

guides.title: 3 ways to start stepping back this week
guides.summary: Always stepping in? Learn how to stop rescuing your child so they build resilience, problem-solving, and grit. When to help, when to wait, and why struggle matters.

guides.title: 3 ways to practice this week
guides.summary: Stop handing kids the answer. Learn how asking 'what's your plan?' builds problem-solving, initiative, and leadership — and raises a child who thinks for themselves.

guides.title: How to repair, step by step
guides.summary: Yelled at your kid and feel awful? What you do next matters more than the slip. Learn how to repair after yelling and turn the moment into trust and security.

guides.title: How to let your child fail safely
guides.summary: Letting your child fail feels wrong, but it's how grit is built. Learn why safe, small failures grow resilience, problem-solving, and confidence in kids.

guides.title: 3 rules to keep it fun
guides.summary: Want to raise an entrepreneurial kid? Give your child $5 and a challenge. Learn how a tiny money mission builds initiative, problem-solving, and real-world confidence.
